title: Palm Springs Police Department organizational sheet (October 2024)
key_finding: Official village publication identifies an active Palm Springs Police Department at 230 Cypress Lane with patrol, investigations, support services, and village-employed police staffing.

title: Village Departments - Police
key_finding: The village's official departments page has a dedicated Police section with divisions, police-record links, and safety resources, confirming current municipal police operations.

title: Police Support Services
key_finding: The Records Unit is located in the Police Department lobby at 230 Cypress Lane and handles police-record requests, providing the clearest official local records-retrieval path.

title: FY 2025 Annual Budget
key_finding: The FY2025 budget describes the Palm Springs Police Department as the village's law-enforcement provider and budgets 78 full-time police positions.

title: Annual Comprehensive Financial Report FY 2024
key_finding: The FY2024 ACFR organizational chart shows a Police Chief in the village structure and the report includes a Police Officers Pension Plan, confirming a village-run police function.

title: Annual Comprehensive Financial Report FY 2022
key_finding: The FY2022 ACFR still labeled the same village function under a Public Safety Director, which explains legacy 'Public Safety Department' naming without indicating sheriff replacement.

title: Police Department Directory
key_finding: FDLE's March 24, 2026 police directory lists Palm Springs Police Department with Chief Rolando Silva at 230 Cypress Lane.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020
key_finding: FDLE published a populated Palm Springs Police Department municipal offense row in 2020 with population 23,867 and total index crime 1,072.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A
key_finding: FDLE kept Palm Springs Police Department as a municipal row in 2021 but blanked the offense and rate cells.

title: Florida Incident-Based Report Reporting System (FIBRS)
key_finding: FDLE's current FIBRS page links the statewide offense workbook for the 2021-2025 Q3 reporting cycles.

title: FIBRS Offense Detail 2021-2025 Q3
key_finding: Direct workbook inspection found no Palm Springs row on the 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 Q3 sheets.
